# @pencroff-lab/kore

> TypeScript core utilities library providing value-based error handling
> with a Go-style `Err` type and `flow`, a tier of free functions over
> `ResultTuple<T>`. Published to npm as a dual ESM/CJS package.
> The `Outcome<T>` class is deprecated and frozen since v0.7.0.

## Core Modules

- [Err](src/types/err.ts): Immutable, value-based error type with wrapping (cause chains), aggregation, hierarchical error codes, JSON serialization, and conversion to native Error. `Err.isErr` is nominal (`instanceof`) since v0.7.0; reconstruct wire data with `Err.from`
- [flow](src/flow/flow.ts): The primary API — free functions over `ResultTuple<T>` (`readonly [T, null] | readonly [null, Err]`): `ok`, `fail`, `attempt`/`attemptAsync`, `copy`, `map`/`flatMap`/`mapErr`/`effect` plus async forms, `ensure`, the `onOk`/`onErr`/`onTuple` stage factories, `pipe`/`pipeAsync` (typed through ten stages), `defaultTo` (handler-only), `either`, `all`, `any`, `fromJSON`. Every fallible callback returns a `ResultTuple`; the error slot is the only failure signal, and `map` is the one callback whose return is never inspected
- [flow test helpers](src/flow/test.ts): `expectOk` / `expectErr`, published from the `@pencroff-lab/kore/test` subpath only
- [Outcome](src/types/outcome.ts): **Deprecated, frozen.** Monadic result container wrapping `[T, null] | [null, Err]` with map/pipe chains, combinators (all, any), side effects, and terminal operations. Callbacks follow the value protocol (`Err` = failure, `Outcome` = passthrough, anything else = the success value); `fromTuple`/`fromTupleAsync` are the only tuple entry points, and `toTuple()` is the only extraction
- [Logger](src/utils/logger.ts): Structured, level-filtered logging with pluggable transports and Err integration
- [dtStamp](src/utils/format_dt.ts): Compact, sortable date/time stamps for file names, log prefixes, and IDs

## Type Definitions

- [Err types](src/types/err.types.ts): ErrCode, ErrOptions, ErrJSON, ToStringOptions
- [Shared types](src/types/common.types.ts): ResultTuple — the single readonly declaration shared by both tiers
- [flow types](src/flow/flow.types.ts): Op, OpAsync, AnyOp, AsyncSource, OkValue, OkValues
- [Outcome types](src/types/outcome.types.ts): CallbackReturn, ValueOf, PipeFn, PipeFnAsync (re-exports ResultTuple)

## Usage Examples

- [Err examples](src/types/err.examples.test.ts): Error creation, wrapping, codes, serialization
- [flow examples](src/flow/flow.examples.test.ts): Boundaries, the callback protocol, transformations, pipelines, collections, serialization, input protection
- [flow test helper examples](src/flow/test.examples.test.ts): Asserting on result tuples
- [Outcome examples](src/types/outcome.examples.test.ts): Mapping, piping, combinators, error handling
- [Logger examples](src/utils/logger.examples.test.ts): Log levels, transports, child loggers
- [dtStamp examples](src/utils/format_dt.examples.test.ts): Date formatting options

## Guides

- [Flow operation flows](docs/guides/flow-operation-flows.md): Creating results, exception boundaries, transformations, pipelines, combinators, terminal operations, serialization, input protection
- [Error handling patterns](docs/guides/error-handling-patterns.md): Err composition, propagation, the nominal type guard, real-world scenarios
- [Migration map](README.md#migrating-from-outcome): Outcome operation to flow equivalent
- [Migration from throwing](docs/guides/migration-from-throwing.md): Step-by-step try/catch to result tuple conversion

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Full development rules, architecture, and conventions
- [API reference](docs/api/): Generated TypeDoc documentation

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { Err, ok, fail, pipe, onOk, onErr, defaultTo } from "@pencroff-lab/kore";
import { dtStamp, log, createLogger } from "@pencroff-lab/kore";
import { expectOk, expectErr } from "@pencroff-lab/kore/test";
```

## Install

```bash
npm install @pencroff-lab/kore
```
